response.original_title: How do I escalate an issue with Xfinity? [Nov 2026 Help]
response.overview: "To escalate an issue with Xfinity, call +1-866-465-1426 for a Tier 2 floor supervisor, or file a case via get help. Keep your 16-digit account number and earlier ticket IDs ready so the supervisor can act right away.  Four steps to escalate your Xfinity issue 1. Start by phone: Call +1-866-465-1426 and confirm your 16-digit account number or primary phone number. 2. Explain the issue: Ask for a warm transfer to an on-duty Tier 2 supervisor so your case notes stay attached. 3. Share your records: Share your prior ticket numbers and the exact dates your service dropped. 4. Save your confirmation: Write down the supervisor's badge ID and your master case number.
